reason: The agent only added a NULL check for s_p in json_array_append and a NULL-charset fallback in json_string_set_cs; other path functions (json_insert/json_set/json_replace/json_remove) still proceed with an un-set-up path when the path argument evaluates to NULL. The hidden test 'SELECT ... json_insert('1', ('x' % 'x'), 1, '$.a', 2) ...' still crashes the server in json_string_set_cs via Item_func_json_insert::val_str. The fix covers only one of the affected functions, so the crash class the issue reports is not fixed.

The agent keeps val_str_ascii() and just rejects ill-formed utf8mb3 bytes in Sql_path::from_text, so non-UTF8 input is never converted. Valid non-ASCII values like 'SET PATH _latin1 0xE5' (and the swe7 repro from the issue) now fail with ER_WRONG_VALUE_FOR_VAR instead of being stored as `å`/`é`. The crash is gone, but this turns a charset-handling bug into a false rejection of legitimate identifiers. The test fails at line 9 on that statement.

The agent rejects INTERVAL expressions that contain a PS parameter (with_param()) after fix_fields, which fixes the PREPARE '?' crash the issue describes (both '?' cases pass). The developers chose to reject every non-constant INTERVAL (SP variables, user variables, @@sysvars, RAND, CONCAT) before fix_fields, and the tests check that. The run fails because the SP-variable case 'CREATE PROCEDURE p(v INT) ... INTERVAL v DAY' still crashes in Item_splocal::fix_fields, a case the issue never mentions. This could also be counted as W for a missed sibling crash.

The agent sets killed_ptr and adds JSON_DO_PAUSE_EXECUTION for the 11.4 functions, and func_json_notembedded (the timeout test the issue asks for) passes. func_json fails only because the developers added a new warning, 'Syntax error in JSON text in argument 2 to function json_array_intersect at position 1', when the second argument is a valid non-array JSON value. That is an mtr warning the issue does not specify (no parse error happens there), so it is a mismatch with the expected output.

The agent's change in open_and_lock_internal_tables avoids the mysql_lock_merge(NULL, ...) crash. However, the hidden test 'ALTER TABLE t FORCE, ALGORITHM=COPY, LOCK=EXCLUSIVE' with a NEXTVAL default still crashes the server, now in mysql_alter_table (sql_table.cc:11023). The developers also had to stop open_table from treating the sequence's flushed share as a reopen condition. The agent's fix is incomplete and the issue's repro still crashes.

The agent quotes the directory with append_unescaped(), which escapes a single quote by doubling it ('o''hara'). The developers used append_for_single_quote(), which emits a backslash escape ('o\'hara'). Both are valid, re-parseable SQL and fix the issue. The symlink.result line 'DATA DIRECTORY='MYSQL_TMP_DIR/o\'hara/'' differs only in the escaping style, which the issue does not specify.
